papers.title: Preconditioning for quadratic matrix optimization via constraint reshaping
papers.summary: We study quadratic optimization over orthogonality or symplectic constraints, a problem arising in eigenvalue computation, subspace analysis, and reduced-order modeling. Ill-conditioned problems have a wide positive Hessian spectrum at a minimizer, which slows first-order Riemannian methods. Existing preconditioned-metric approaches choose a Riemannian metric, which determines the resulting Hessian spectrum. We instead redesign the problem itself to find the narrowest possible spectrum. We reshape the constraints into equivalent formulations that preserve the optimal value and the solution set, giving a family of preconditioned problems parametrized by positive constraint weights. We derive a closed form for the positive Hessian spectrum in terms of these weights. Minimizing the condition number then reduces to a linear program (LP) in the logarithms of the weights. The LP attains a globally optimal design within the paired equal-block family, and its strong duality gives matching lower bounds on the condition number. On tested instances, the optimized formulation substantially reduces the local condition number, with returned spectra matching predictions on both orthogonal and symplectic instances. We also benchmark the design against Lagrangian and left-right preconditioned metrics. The method thus provides an exact, optimization-based alternative to heuristic preconditioned metrics.
papers.title_ja: 制約の再構成による二次行列最適化の前処理
papers.summary_ja: 直交性やシンプレクティック制約付き二次最適化において、初期化や収束速度を左右するヘッセ行列の条件数を改善する手法を提案する。既存のリーマン計量ベースの前処理とは異なり、制約条件を等価な形式に再構成することで、ヘッセスペクトラムを狭める問題自体を設計する。正の制約重みパラメータを用いた閉形式のスペクトラム導出を行い、条件数の最小化を対数変換後の線形計画（LP）として定式化する。このLPにより、ペアリングされた等ブロック族内で大域最適解が得られ、数値実験では既存の前処理手法と比較して局所条件数が大幅に低減されることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルや固有値計算の高速化に直結する最適化手法であり、ML手法全般との親和性が高い。

papers.title: Calibrated Decision Rewards: Training Language Models with a Judge That Knows How Sure It Is
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can only teach a language model what its reward can recognize. Answer checkers are exact but need a reference answer; learned reward models and LLM judges work everywhere, but their scores are not probabilities. We study RLCDR (Reinforcement Learning from Calibrated Decision Rewards). An LLM converted into a decision model answers a typed question about a response ("is the final answer correct?", "which step is the first error?") with a probability distribution, read in one forward pass, debiased over option orders and calibrated with about a hundred labels. Training Qwen3-1.7B with GRPO on MATH, this reference-free reward raises MATH500 accuracy from 72.2% to 76.8% (+4.65 points, p < 1e-4), matching training on the answer key (76.9%), while a random reward gains only +0.65. The gain grows with difficulty, from 44.8% to 51.7% on the hardest level. On the policy's own changing samples the reward stays calibrated: its expected calibration error is half that of a softmax judge on the same 27B backbone (0.074 vs. 0.141), and it shows no sign of reward hacking. Without step training, the same model finds the first wrong step better than a dedicated 7B process reward model (ProcessBench F1 0.772 vs. 0.722, 20/20 splits). We also map where the approach stops being enough: trained only on problems the base model mostly fails, the reference-free reward still improves the policy (+1.9 MATH500 points, p = 0.03) but trails the answer key, because its probabilities become overconfident on that distribution. We state six hypotheses in advance and test each with a control designed to falsify it.
papers.title_ja: 較正済み決定報酬：確信度を認識するジャッジによる言語モデルの学習
papers.summary_ja: LLMを決定モデルとして活用し、回答の正誤や誤りの箇所を確率分布として出力する「較正済み決定報酬（RLCDR）」手法を提案する。この報酬モデルは少数のラベルで較正され、GRPOを用いた強化学習において参照解答なしでMATH500の精度を向上させ、解答キーを用いた学習と同等の性能を発揮した。さらに、報酬ハッキングの兆候がなく、期待較正誤差が従来のソフトマックスジャッジより低く、プロセス報酬モデルを上回る誤り検出能力を示した。ただし、ベースモデルが失敗しやすい問題に限定して学習した場合、確率の過信により性能が低下する限界も確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの強化学習・報酬設計・評価手法の改善に直結する高度な研究

papers.title: Rate-distortion Assessment for Hierarchical Content Summarization
papers.summary: Powerful generative models including large language and vision models have demonstrated success across a wide range of content generation, editing and manipulation tasks via end-to-end prompt-based generation. However, current assessment of the quality of generative content manipulation remains subjective, limiting scientific understanding of model capabilities. Inspired by rate-distortion theory from Shannon information compression theory, in this work we formalize hierarchical content summarization as an information encoding problem. We design a principled framework to extract the semantic hierarchy of the source content to support quantitative characterization of the rate-distortion trade-off between compression efficiency (rate) against information loss (distortion) during generative content manipulation, which allows us to benchmark various models with respect to performance conditional on rate budget of interest. We demonstrate the use of the framework with empirical experiments on content summarization for long-context question-answering with state-of-the-art large language models, offering new insights into their efficiency and comprehension capabilities. We further demonstrate the use of the semantic hierarchy as guidance for performing effective retrieval augmented generation, showing improved rate-distortion characteristics against current baselines.
papers.title_ja: 階層的コンテンツ要約におけるレート・ディストーション評価
papers.summary_ja: 生成AIモデルの出力品質評価が主観的である問題を解決するため、シャノンの情報圧縮理論に基づくレート・ディストーション理論を適用した枠組みを提案する。ソースコンテンツのセマンティック階層を抽出し、圧縮効率（レート）と情報損失（ディストーション）のトレードオフを定量的に特徴付け、モデル間のベンチマーク評価を可能にする。長文コンテキストの質問応答におけるLLMの実験を通じて、効率性と理解能力に関する新たな知見を得た。さらに、このセマンティック階層をRAG（検索拡張生成）のガイドとして活用することで、既存ベースラインと比較してレート・ディストーション特性が向上することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化評価とRAG設計の改善に直結する手法

papers.title: Separating Interpretability and Reconstruction in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are effective tools for mechanistic interpretability by decomposing neural representations into sparse and interpretable features. However, a single sparse representation in traditional SAEs is responsible for both reconstruction fidelity and interpretability, which are not guaranteed to align. To separate these objectives, we propose DualSAE, a modular framework that augments standard SAEs with a plug-in Residual Branch. A standard SAE serves as the Sparse Branch, learning a sparse code that contains the dominant semantics of the input. The added Residual Branch models the non-semantic information omitted by the Sparse Branch. We ensure that the contributions of the two branches towards the overall reconstruction have minimal overlap through a decorrelation loss. We also adopt a two-stage training strategy that first stabilizes sparse representation learning before coupling with the Residual Branch. Across diverse encoder-SAE configurations on two vision datasets and two language corpora, DualSAE achieves mean relative improvements of approximately 29% in reconstruction fidelity and 34% in interpretability (measured by monosemanticity score). Moreover, with more interpretable representations, DualSAE yields consistent performance gains in the downstream applications of topic modeling, hypothesis generation, and LLM steering. Qualitative analysis further suggests that the Sparse Branch indeed preserves dominant semantic content, whereas the Residual Branch captures non-semantic information to improve reconstruction fidelity.
papers.title_ja: スパースオートエンコーダにおける解釈可能性と再構成の分離
papers.summary_ja: スパースオートエンコーダ（SAE）において、再構成精度と解釈可能性が必ずしも一致しない問題に対し、Sparse Branch と Residual Branch を持つ DualSAE フレームワークを提案する。Sparse Branch は主要な意味論的特徴を、Residual Branch は非意味論的情報を学習し、デコレレーション損失により両者の重複を最小化する。視覚・言語データセットでの実験により、再構成精度約29%、解釈可能性約34%の向上を実証した。さらに、トピックモデリングや LLM スティーアリングなどの下流タスクでも一貫した性能向上を確認している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の解釈可能性向上と下流タスク応用が関心と一致

papers.title: Game-Theoretic Data Allocation for Expert Specialization and Routing
papers.summary: Can the allocation used to train experts also predict which expert will perform best on a prompt? Such a connection would make the intended division of labor inspectable before training and allow the allocation itself to guide inference. We introduce InflEns, a mixture of LoRA experts whose training weights and inference routes come from the same location game in a fixed prompt-trait space. Players choose positions to maximize their expected shares of the prompt distribution, without using expert losses. We utilize the game's kernel-general theoretical criterion for when co-located positions become locally unstable to separation. We evaluate InflEns on a corpus assembled from seven safety-related benchmarks, which demonstrates that the highest-share expert has the lowest held-out response negative log-likelihood (NLL) on approximately 90% of prompts across four kernels under a sharpened simplex representation, compared with approximately 15% after permuting allocations across prompts. We demonstrate that the method performs comparably to published learned gates without having to train an explicit gate on the experts. Because the router is fixed, we can trace harmful behavior to a single expert and retrain only that expert, which lowers HarmBench attack success from 0.51 to 0.02 while keeping instruction following. The game also gives us several controls over how the experts specialize, including the kernel choice and its parameters, the trait-space geometry, and the number of experts. Importantly, InflEns is a general framework that can be extended to any encoder and data distribution.
papers.title_ja: エキスパート特化とルーティングのためのゲーム理論的データ割当
papers.summary_ja: LoRAエキスパートの訓練データ割当と推論時のルーティングを、プロンプト特性空間における位置ゲームで統一するフレームワークInflEnsを提案する。損失関数を用いずに、プロンプト分布の期待シェア最大化に基づきエキスパートの役割分担を決定し、訓練前の段階で役割の可視化と推論導引を実現する。7つの安全性ベンチマークを用いた評価では、最高シェアのエキスパートが約90%のプロンプトで最良のNLLを示し、学習済みゲートと同等以上の性能を発揮した。さらに、有害な挙動を特定エキスパートに追跡・再訓練することで、HarmBenchの攻撃成功率を大幅に低減しつつ指示追従性を維持できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・ルーティング設計と安全性評価に直結する手法

papers.title: Blind Spots Travel, Knowledge Stays Home: What RL Inherits from an LLM Judge
papers.summary: LLM judges serve as rewards where no answer key exists, in the hope that their knowledge passes to the trained model. In 814 RL runs that teach 7-8B models to answer closed-book questions or abstain, we ask what passes. What a grader knows about single answers stays home. A wrong answer that a judge rewards is memorised for that one question. A model trained with the answer key, or with a far stronger judge, chooses which new questions to answer no better than the untrained model does by sampling 32 answers and abstaining where they disagree; the grader's knowledge adds about one corrected answer per hundred questions. What a grader believes about a kind of question travels. A judge that rejects eleven of the twelve correct training answers about capitals of former states teaches the model to refuse 98% of such capitals on new questions, a loss that accuracy and abstention rates do not reveal. Changing only those twelve verdicts by hand moves the refusal from 5% to 90%, even for a grader that accepts as many answers as the answer key; at that leniency, two of four judges already cost 38-42% of these capitals. The capitals are not forgotten: with "I don't know" blocked, the model answers 94% of them correctly. The grader therefore needs no knowledge of its own: rewarding the model for giving the answer that most of its own untrained samples agree on, with no labels and no judge, earns the answer key's reward and keeps the category.
papers.title_ja: 盲点は移動し、知識は家に残る：LLMジャッジからRLが継承するもの
papers.summary_ja: LLMをジャッジとして用いた強化学習（RL）において、個々の正解知識はモデルに伝播しないが、質問カテゴリに対する拒否傾向（バイアス）は強く伝播することを814回の実験で示した。ジャッジの判定が偏ると、モデルは新規質問でも過度に回答を拒否し、精度や棄権率からは検出できない性能劣化が生じる。この問題に対し、ラベルや外部ジャッジを使わず、モデル自身のサンプリング結果の合意度に基づいて報酬を与える手法が、正解キー同等の性能とカテゴリ知識の保持を両立させることを提案した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのRL強化と評価手法の改善に直結する重要な知見

papers.title: Learning to Read Events for Exact State Tracking with Frozen Language Models
papers.summary: Long event streams require identifying each change and applying the changes in order. We train a selector on a frozen language model to read each transition. With API-only access, we ask the model to list the transitions. An external integer register composes them in order. A confidence rule can flag uncertain updates or retain several candidates. We study products of permutations of five items, a task that fixed-depth, log-precision transformers cannot solve on all input lengths under the standard conjecture that $\mathrm{TC}^0 \ne \mathrm{NC}^1$. On two-event windows, a 27B model answered 3 of 100 correctly without visible reasoning and 96 of 100 when it generated intermediate steps. A frozen 0.8B model with a trained selector read every event in 299 of 299 windows of 43,687 events each. The same package passed 298 of 299 new windows on a fresh machine, missing the target of 0.99 for the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound. A separate follow-up sized to allow one failure yielded 472 of 473. On 1,000-event room-swap documents, three of ten models solved all five documents by reasoning alone. All seven models tested both ways at this length solved all five with extraction and the register, with no chain of thought requested. With concurrent extraction, median wall-clock time fell from 136.1 to 10.4 s for Sonnet 5.5 and from 313.5 to 28.0 s for GPT-6.1 Sol. At fixed per-token rates, mean cost per document fell by 55% for Sonnet 5.5 and 44% for GPT-6.1 Sol. A regular expression with an executor also solved all 15 fixed-format documents. On 500 free-form issue-tracker comments, a separately adapted 4B reader identified the recorded value in 68.8% of cases, compared with 61.0% for a frequency baseline fitted on the same training projects.
papers.title_ja: 凍結された言語モデルによる正確な状態追跡のためのイベント読み取り学習
papers.summary_ja: 凍結されたLLMに外部セレクタを組み合わせ、長文のイベントストリームから状態遷移を正確に抽出・順序付けする手法を提案する。固定深さのTransformerでは解けない複雑な順列積タスクにおいて、中間ステップ生成なしで高正解率を達成した。さらに、並列抽出により推論時間を大幅に短縮し、コストも削減できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化・高速化とエージェント設計に直結する手法

papers.title: Some Memories Must Fade: Persistence and Decay of User Memories in Model Parameters
papers.summary: Parametric memory allows Large Language Models to internalize knowledge directly into their weights, offering a potentially powerful alternative to retrieval-based memory (RAG). However, existing approaches to parametric memory are difficult to deploy as they largely mirror the Continual Learning (CL) objective of retaining information indefinitely. This is neither sustainable nor sufficient for a memory system, which must govern knowledge across its lifecycle by retaining stable facts, reinforcing recurring observations, updating changed beliefs, and allowing transient information to fade. We propose a system for parametric memory management consisting of a memory substrate (handling information storage and forgetting) and a learned policy (what to remember, how deeply, and for how long). Our substrate is a fixed-capacity LoRA adapter that consists of k-hot rank combinations which store facts without catastrophic interference and maintain an independently controlled temporal decay, enabling outdated information to fade while long-term facts persist. On this substrate, we train a lightweight controller that governs each incoming user event to ensure the memory system reflects the user's true, updated belief state. To evaluate how memory systems manage user memory, we introduce a controlled dataset of long-horizon user trajectories with varying persistence of facts based on changing belief states and user-behavioral shifts, and probe queries that test recall while information is valid and abstention after it expires. Our policy learns to effectively manage user memory over its entire lifecycle, balancing recall and abstention to achieve 86% of oracle performance, unlike CL and RAG baselines that primarily default to one of the two behaviors. By providing the first system to manage memory directly in model weights, this work establishes a foundation for long-horizon parametric memory.
papers.title_ja: 一部の記憶は消えなければならない：モデルパラメータにおけるユーザー記憶の持続と減衰
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMのパラメトリックメモリにおいて、情報の持続と忘却を管理する新しいシステムを提案する。固定容量のLoRAアダプタを用いたメモリ基盤と、記憶の深さや期間を制御する軽量コントローラーから構成される。この仕組みにより、陳腐化した情報は減衰し、重要な事実は保持される。長期的なユーザー行動変化を含む新規データセットで評価し、RAGや継続学習ベースラインを上回る86%のオラクル性能を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのメモリ管理とRAG代替手法であり、効率化・エージェント設計に直結する

papers.title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
papers.summary: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. Second, the agents' advantage is a design made on each machine's data; once made, a plain-text plan of a few hundred words carries most of the gap between two frontier agents, and given a weaker agent's plan, the strongest agent falls to that agent's level, often to identical predictions. Before touching the data, however, it matters little whose plan an agent carries out, and domain toolkits appear to help neither: what sets the strongest apart is how much it learns from the data. Third, such designs reach only implementers that can execute them: given the strongest agent's designs, a locally deployable open-weight model delivers half as often, even when they are lightened, and scores no higher than without them. Generality, we argue, is not disappearing but moving, from the model to the modeler.
papers.title_ja: モデルからモデラーへ汎用性を移す：PHM向けLLMエージェントとデプロイメント型ベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、予知保全（PHM）タスクにおいてLLMエージェントがAutoMLや既存手法を上回る性能を発揮することを、新規ベンチマーク「NextUnit-Bench」で示す。エージェントの優位性は汎用モデルではなく、個々の機器データに基づき設計される個別の予測器（プラン）にあると結論づける。さらに、この設計能力は強力なモデルに依存し、軽量なオープンウェイトモデルでは再現が困難であることも指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と実務向けベンチマーク評価が関心に合致

papers.title: Cross-Question Reliable Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: AI systems operating near the limits of their capabilities can maximize utility while minimizing the risk of error by abstaining or deferring questions they are not confident about to a human or a stronger model. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been post-trained to estimate confidence in their own answers. To achieve this, methods reinforce confidence scores based on the correctness signal to each question-answer pair individually, with rewards that encourage assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect answers. However, estimating confidence scores is useful in that it enables selecting only the most confident answers, to maximize the share of solved questions while accommodating the user's risk tolerance. Assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect ones is theoretically optimal, but unattainable in practice and detrimental for selective prediction with a non-zero risk tolerance: confidences pushed to 0 and 1 carry no information about how answers compare to one another. We therefore introduce CARE (Cross-question Abstention Reward Estimation), which computes rewards over a set of question-answer pairs: At each of several risk tolerances, the confidences across the set induce an abstention threshold, and each confidence is rewarded for lying on the correct side of it. Since the threshold itself comes from the set, every verbalized confidence is reinforced relative to other questions' confidence, not against its own binary correctness label. On math, CARE increases the coverage at 5% risk (C@5) across MATH-500, GSM8K, and Big-Math-Digits from 0.8% to 42.4%, compared to existing pointwise correctness-matching rewards. When trained on multi-hop Wikipedia QA from HotpotQA, CARE improves C@5 in out-of-distribution general-knowledge, reasoning, and math benchmarks (including CommonsenseQA, GPQA, SimpleQA, and TriviaQA) from 12.3% to 23.6%.
papers.title_ja: クロス・クエッション信頼性強化学習
papers.summary_ja: LLMが回答の信頼度を推定し、リスク許容度に応じて回答を保留（アブステイン）する選択的予測の精度を向上させる手法CAREを提案する。従来の個別正解シグナルに基づく報酬設計では信頼度が0または1に極端化し、相対的な比較情報が失われる問題に対し、質問セット全体の信頼度分布に基づいて閾値を動的に設定し、その閾値に対する相対的な位置に基づいて報酬を計算する。これにより、MATH-500やGSM8Kなどの数学ベンチマークにおいて、5%リスク許容度時のカバレッジ（C@5）を大幅に改善し、HotpotQAでの学習によりOut-of-Distributionな一般知識や推論タスクでも性能向上を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論信頼性向上とハルシネーション対策に直結する手法

papers.title: BuggyMLE: Scaling Machine Learning Engineering Difficulty with Bug Injection
papers.summary: Enabling AI systems to autonomously improve AI models requires agents capable of performing machine learning engineering (MLE). In practice, designing, training, and evaluating complex models demands modifying multi-file repositories to reproduce results, debug training runs, integrate datasets, and port frameworks. However, existing MLE benchmarks limit agents to single-file edits without full repository or shell access, and common repository-level software engineering benchmarks have rapidly saturated. To address this, we introduce the Code Complexity Index (CCI), a difficulty metric based on ten structural features spanning repository scale, dependency depth, and patch size. CCI strongly predicts average solve rates across eight public coding benchmarks ($R^2 = 0.951$), identifying patch size and complexity as top predictors. Guided by CCI, we develop BuggyMLE, a scalable framework where agents inject controlled mutations into working ML repositories, synthesizing over 6,600 bug-injected MLE repository variants and nearly 260K lines of injected code based on 222 source repositories. Using BuggyMLE, we make two contributions. First, we construct BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite, the first difficulty-graded, repository-level variant of MLE-Bench Lite; across 14 evaluated models, the top solve rate drops from 95% to 9% as difficulty is scaled from the easiest to the hardest tier. Second, we synthesize a training curriculum across three difficulty levels over 200 additional ML repositories, fine-tuning a Qwen3.5-9B model to rival frontier models on BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite. Our trained model transfers beyond ML, raising its SWE-bench Lite resolve rate from 24% to 33% and its LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 from 69% to 71%.
papers.title_ja: BuggyMLE: バグ注入による機械学習エンジニアリング難易度のスケーリング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、AIエージェントの機械学習エンジニアリング（MLE）能力を評価・向上させるための新フレームワーク「BuggyMLE」を提案する。リポジトリ規模や依存関係の深さなど10項目からなる「コード複雑度指数（CCI）」を定義し、これに基づいて動作するMLリポジトリに制御されたバグを注入することで、6,600件以上の難易度段階付きタスクを生成した。このベンチマークを用いることで、既存の単一ファイル編集制限を突破し、リポジトリ全体でのデバッグや統合能力を測定可能にする。さらに、このデータセットでQwen3.5-9Bをファインチューニングした結果、フロンティアモデルに匹敵する性能を発揮し、SWE-bench Liteなどの汎用ソフトウェアエンジニアリングタスクでも性能向上が確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価ベンチマークの高度化に直結する手法

papers.title: {\phi}TD: Distributional Reinforcement Learning using Characteristic Functions
papers.summary: Distributional Reinforcement Learning methods aim to learn the entire distribution of returns, yet current algorithmic approaches are limited to a narrow class of distributions. We propose $\varphi$TD, a method to overcome this limitation by computing the loss in the frequency domain. We demonstrate that this further unifies quantile and categorical approaches to distributional RL, and enables the learning of distributions that were previously impossible to capture, such as mixtures of continuous distributions. We empirically study $\varphi$TD, across synthetic benchmarks and large-scale deep RL environments and demonstrate that the flexibility obtained from wider parametric families can lead to improved performance.
papers.title_ja: φTD: 特性関数を用いた分布的強化学習
papers.summary_ja: 分布的強化学習において、従来の手法が扱える分布のクラスが限定的であるという問題を解決するため、周波数領域で損失を計算する新しい手法φTDを提案する。この手法は、分位数ベースとカテゴリカルベースのアプローチを統一し、連続分布の混合など従来は学習が困難だった複雑な分布の学習を可能にする。合成ベンチマークおよび大規模な深層強化学習環境での実験により、より広いパラメトリックファミリーを用いることで性能が向上することが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の手法全般に関心があり、分布的RLという高度なトピックを含むため

papers.title: ICARE: cross-domain text classification with incremental class-aware representation and distillation learning
papers.summary: The rise of powerful, fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) necessitates robust natural language inference (NLI) systems. These NLI systems ideally train across various tasks, encompassing diverse concepts like sentiment analysis, news classification, and coreference resolution. However, this continual, multi-tasking approach can lead to catastrophic forgetting, where previously learned tasks are lost, especially in domains lacking specific labels. Rehearsing past examples with labels can further exacerbate this issue by causing overfitting, hindering the system's ability to classify new categories. To tackle these challenges, this research proposes ICARE, a novel framework with two key components: an instance selection module and a knowledge distillation method. The former is based on representation learning, which meticulously selects training examples to present to the NLI system. The latter, knowledge distillation with feature and logit-level transfer, facilitates knowledge transfer between tasks. This leverages pruning techniques and optimized objective functions to transfer both essential feature-level and decision-making (logit-level) knowledge, mitigating catastrophic forgetting while adapting to new patterns. Extensive evaluations on benchmark text classification datasets have demonstrated ICARE's effectiveness. The framework achieves a significant improvement in target accuracy and reduction in the ``forgetting metric''. These results solidify ICARE's ability to preserve and leverage learned knowledge across diverse tasks, ultimately enhancing the adaptability and performance of NLI systems. The source code is available at https://github.com/CongSon01/ICARE_NLP.git
papers.title_ja: ICARE: 増分クラス認識表現と蒸留学習によるクロスドメインテキスト分類
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の継続学習における「カタストロフィック・フォーゲッティング（既習知識の忘却）」問題を解決するフレームワークICAREを提案する。表現学習に基づくインスタンス選択モジュールと、特徴量レベルおよびロジットレベルの知識蒸留を組み合わせることで、タスク間の知識移転を促進する。ベンチマーク評価により、ターゲットタスクの精度向上と忘却指標の低減が確認され、多様なテキスト分類タスクへの適応性が示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・継続学習・蒸留手法に関わるため

papers.title: Old-School Planners Drive (Sometimes) Better Than Learned Ones
papers.summary: End-to-end driving models learn to plan from data, and hand-written planners are widely treated as a thing of the past. We test whether this is justified: we implement sixteen textbook planners, each combining a path source (reference line, A*, hybrid A*, RRT*) with a trajectory method (Frenet lattice, nonlinear optimization, $s$--$t$ search, dynamic window), and evaluate them on three benchmarks: open loop on nuScenes, closed loop on nuPlan with ground-truth perception, and photorealistic closed loop on HUGSIM. On HUGSIM, they replace only the planner of the end-to-end model UniAD and read its frozen perception, without an HD map or other privileged information. On nuScenes and nuPlan, the best textbook planners are competitive (L2 error of 0.735\,m against 0.947\,m for UniAD's planner; a nuPlan score of 79.3 against 76.1 for the rule-based PDM-Closed on Test14-hard with reactive agents). On HUGSIM, nine of the sixteen score above UniAD's learned planner on the same perception,. The best, a hybrid A* path followed by nonlinear trajectory optimization, raises HUGSIM's driving score (HD-Score) from 32.0 to 41.8. The gain is largest with standing and oncoming cars; against cars that steer at the ego, there is none. In 31 of the 182 runs in which UniAD's planner hits a car, the best textbook planner completes the route on the same perception: these crashes are due to the planner, not the perception.
papers.title_ja: 古典的なプランナーは（時には）学習型プランナーを上回る
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、自動運転における手書きの古典的プランナー16種を、A*やRRT*などの経路生成とFrenet格子や非線形最適化などの軌道生成の組み合わせとして実装し、nuScenes、nuPlan、HUGSIMの3つのベンチマークで評価した。結果、特にHUGSIM環境では、UniADの学習型プランナーに代わって古典的プランナーを使用することで、HD-Scoreが32.0から41.8へ向上し、9種が学習型を上回る性能を示した。また、クラッシュの多くは知覚ではなくプランニングに起因しており、ハイブリッドA*と非線形最適化の組み合わせが特に有効であることが判明した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道最適化手法の応用だが、対象が自動運転であり宇宙分野ではないため中程度

papers.title: Differentiable Hydrodynamics for Whole-Body MPC of Underwater Robots
papers.summary: Underwater vehicle-manipulator systems distribute actuation across thrusters and joint motors. Whole-body model predictive control (MPC), rather than separate vehicle and arm controllers, can coordinate both to extend the workspace and exploit the system's full kinematic capability. Doing so, however, requires a hydrodynamic model and derivatives throughout the prediction horizon. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) captures geometry-dependent forces and moments for such a model, but is too expensive to evaluate online. We present a differentiable analytical hydrodynamic model combining smooth spherical-harmonic force and moment fields with a coupled added-inertia matrix identified from CFD. It compactly represents velocity and acceleration-dependent loads and provides their derivatives in closed form. These derivatives are propagated through free-floating vehicle--manipulator dynamics for whole-body trajectory optimization and receding-horizon control, jointly optimizing thruster forces and joint torques for reaching and continuous tracking. Held-out CFD tests validate the principal translational-force and rotational-moment fields and the added-inertia response. The analytical Jacobians evaluate faster and avoid the step-size sensitivity of central finite differences. Closed-loop Stonefish experiments demonstrate whole-body MPC in an independent marine simulator. By making geometry-dependent hydrodynamics directly available to gradient-based control, the model incorporates water forces and their sensitivities into motion allocation between the vehicle and arm, rather than treating them only as disturbances.
papers.title_ja: 水中ロボットの全身MPCのための微分可能流体力学
papers.summary_ja: 水中ロボットの全身モデル予測制御（MPC）において、計算コストの高いCFDの代わりに、球面調和場と追加慣性行列を用いた微分可能解析的流体力学モデルを提案する。このモデルは速度・加速度依存の荷重とその導関数を閉形式で提供し、推進力と関節トルクの同時最適化を可能にする。解析的ヤコビアンにより計算速度が向上し、有限差分法のステップサイズ感度問題を回避する。独立した海洋シミュレータでのクローズドループ実験により、全身MPCの有効性が実証された。
papers.relevance_reason: 微分可能モデルと最適化制御の手法は関連するが、対象が水中ロボットであり軌道力学ではないため。

papers.title: Stability Bands for Feature Attribution: The Core, the Nucleolus and the Bargaining Set of Explained-Variance Games
papers.summary: Shapley-value attributions are the default way of explaining machine-learning predictions in economics, but they report a single number per feature and say nothing about whether a coalition of features that jointly accounts for more than it receives could contest that allocation. We study feature attribution through the core, the nucleolus and the bargaining set of an explained-variance game, in which the worth of a set of features is the variance of the model's predictions that those features generate. For every feature we report a stability band (its range of shares over the core, or over the least core when the core is empty), with the nucleolus as distinguished point and a certificate that the allocation admits no justified objection. Three results organise the approach. First, for linear models the game is exactly 2-additive, with pairwise Harsanyi dividends $2\beta_i\beta_j\sigma_{ij}$, so multicollinearity is what creates coalitional structure. Second, in every 2-additive game the prenucleolus coincides with the Shapley value, the (least) core is point-symmetric around it, and the core is non-empty if and only if every cut of the interaction graph has non-negative weight. The Shapley value thus always lies in the prebargaining set, and stability adds information only through band widths and interactions of order three or more. Third, for convex games the bands have a closed form and any allocation can be certified with one minimum cut. In a hedonic price model, the usual mean-SHAP explanation admits a justified objection by the coalition {Ratings, ROM, Battery}. In a gradient-boosting forecaster of retail orders the exact game has an empty core and strong higher-order interactions; the nucleolus departs from the Shapley value by up to 0.19 variance shares, and sparse third-order surrogates recover it where pairwise ones cannot.
papers.title_ja: 特徴量帰属の安定バンド：説明分散ゲームのコア、ヌクレオルス、および交渉集合
papers.summary_ja: 機械学習モデルの説明可能性において、Shapley値が単一の数値しか提供しない限界を克服するため、説明分散ゲームのコア、ヌクレオルス、交渉集合を用いた「安定バンド」の概念を提案する。線形モデルでは多共線性が連合構造を生み、2-additiveゲームではShapley値がヌクレオルスと一致することが示される。凸ゲームではバンドの閉形式解が存在し、最小カットによる証明が可能である。実証では、通常のSHAP説明が正当な異議を許容するケースや、高次相互作用が強い場合のサロゲートモデルの有用性を示している。
papers.relevance_reason: ML手法全般に関わるが、軌道力学やLLM効率化という主要関心とは直接結びつかない

papers.title: A Model of Diverse Sampling from Language Models
papers.summary: Language models often produce high-quality individual samples but poor sets, with repeated samples clustering around the same semantic modes. We formalize diverse generation as sampling a size-$K$ subset of complete strings from a determinantal point process (DPP), where the likelihood encodes item quality, and the embedding geometry encodes repulsion between similar outputs. Exact inference over all strings is intractable, so we propose PoolDPP: draw a finite candidate pool from a tractable proposal, importance-weight the candidates toward the target quality, and run a $K$-DPP sampler on the induced pool kernel; a greedy MAP variant provides deterministic selection. We prove a finite-sample bound with an explicit constant: the KL divergence between the sampler's output and the target $K$-DPP decays as O(1/N) in the pool size. Empirically, PoolDPP extends the quality--diversity frontier on open-ended generation and the precision--recall frontier on ambiguous text-to-SQL (Ambrosia), and on mathematical reasoning (GSM8K), it raises diversity at about the same pass@$K$.
papers.title_ja: 言語モデルからの多様性サンプリングのモデル
papers.summary_ja: 言語モデルが生成するサンプルの多様性を高めるため、決定点過程（DPP）を用いたサンプリング手法を提案する。候補プールから重要度重み付けを行い、DPPサンプラーで多様な出力を選択するPoolDPPアルゴリズムを設計した。有限サンプルにおけるKL発散の収束性を理論的に証明し、O(1/N)の誤差界を導出した。実験では、オープンエンド生成や数学推論タスクにおいて、品質を維持しつつ多様性を向上させることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの出力多様性改善手法であり、推論品質と関連するが、効率化や軌道力学とは無関係。

papers.title: A Verifier from the Past: Test-Time Compute for Time Series Foundation Models
papers.summary: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language models by spending additional inference compute to generate, verify, and select among candidate outputs, but this recipe has not transferred directly to time series forecasting. A language model can verify a proof or vote across samples, but a forecaster must be causal; it cannot use future information to score a candidate. We propose Backtest-Gated Augmentation Averaging (BGAA), a TTC algorithm for time series forecasting that builds a causal verifier from the series's own history, using rolling-origin backtests to score structured views of the context, discard those that underperform the untransformed context, and average the survivors' predictive distributions. BGAA improves every tested TSFM-benchmark combination, reducing MASE by 0.5-1.0% on GIFT-Eval, 1.3-5.0% on fev-bench, and 1.7-5.9% on BOOM, where a 313M model with TTC outperforms the 1B and 2.5B models in its family. We further show that useful views have structured, model-dependent effects consistent with a prior-transport interpretation. On the 53 cross-fittable GIFT-Eval configs, the deployed policy gains only 0.4-1.3% CRPS, versus 1.4-4.1% when choosing the best view for each dataset configuration and 17-19% when choosing the best view separately for each test window. This gap suggests that a major remaining challenge is window-level view selection.
papers.title_ja: 過去からの検証者：時系列基盤モデルにおけるテスト時計算
papers.summary_ja: 時系列予測において、因果性を保ちつつテスト時計算（TTC）を活用するアルゴリズム「BGAA」を提案する。過去データを用いたローリングバックテストで文脈ビューを評価・選別し、残った予測分布を平均することで精度を向上させる。GIFT-EvalなどのベンチマークでMASEを改善し、313Mパラメータモデルが1B・2.5Bモデルを上回る結果を示した。ただし、ウィンドウ単位のビュー選択が今後の課題であることも指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: TTCと検証手法はLLM効率化に関わるが、対象が時系列予測であり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
papers.summary: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a Vision-Language Model (VLM), pre-trained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pre-trained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation, effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system's ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completes kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interprets signs to avoid danger, and evaluates its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.
papers.title_ja: 野外での脚付きロボットナビゲーションにおける視覚言語推論と学習制御の橋渡し
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、視覚言語モデル（VLM）の推論能力と強化学習（RL）によるローカル制御を統合したシステム「ROAM」を提案する。VLMがシーン内のリスクや意味論的ラベルを評価し、セグメンテーションモジュールがリアルタイムのリスクマップを生成することで、RLで学習した歩行・ナビゲーションポリシーを条件付け、複雑な地形での自律移動を実現する。実環境での実験により、キロメートル規模のハイキングや危険回避が可能であることを示したが、VLMの信頼性や空間推論の限界も指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: RLとVLMの統合は関連するが、宇宙・軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: When Objectives and Evaluators Disagree: Evaluating Transfer for Post-hoc Demographic Framing Mitigation
papers.summary: Post-hoc rewriting is used to reduce demographic disparities in LLM-generated text when the source model is inaccessible. A rewrite can look successful merely because it improved its own target or satisfied its selector. We study this as a transfer problem on 660 gender pairs and 1,980 age contrasts of demographic-conditioned climate messages. A rewriter proposes edits, a selection model chooses among constraint-satisfying candidates, and an independent evaluator uninvolved in either rates pairwise framing disparity. A fixed policy that always targets the message with the lower Persuasion Bias Index (PBI) transfers inconsistently across axes and outcome aggregations. An adaptive policy that proposes edits on both sides but accepts at most one significantly improves on that rule, applied to the same candidates, in seven of eight comparisons across two evaluator families, mostly by editing more pairs, not by guided direction choice, at higher preservation risk. A policy editing both messages gives the largest point reductions on fewer pairs. These two policies reduce disparity across a preservation-threshold sweep; absolute ratings vary across evaluator families and prompts. Shrinking the PBI gap increases dimension-mean disparity under both evaluator families. Mitigation should be reported as transfer across objectives, evaluators and their prompts, and editing policies.
papers.title_ja: 目的と評価者が一致しない場合：事後の人口統計学的枠組み緩和における転移の評価
papers.summary_ja: LLM生成テキストにおける人口統計的偏りを事後書き換えで軽減する際、書き換えモデル・選択モデル・独立評価者の間で目的が不一致する問題を「転移」として定式化し、660組の性別ペアと1,980組の年齢対比で検証した。固定ポリシーでは軸や集約方法によって転移が不安定である一方、両側に編集を提案する適応型ポリシーは、より多くのペアを編集することで7/8の比較で改善したが、保持リスクは高まった。PBIギャップの縮小は逆に次元平均の偏りを増大させる傾向があり、緩和効果は評価者やプロンプトによって絶対評価が変動することが示された。したがって、手法の評価は単一の指標ではなく、目的・評価者・編集ポリシー間の転移として報告すべきである。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの公平性評価手法に関わるが、効率化や軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: LLMs Are Already Confidence-Aware Zero-Shot Classifiers
papers.summary: Zero-shot large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as text classifiers, but their labels are only useful when we know to what extent we can trust them. We compare black-box methods (verbalised confidence and sampling) with white-box methods that read token probabilities (P(True), and multiple logit-scoring methods using constrained generation). We evaluate eleven open-weight LLMs (1B-32B parameters) on five classification datasets with 3 to 151 labels, measuring classification performance (accuracy, F1-macro), discrimination (AUROC), and calibration (ECE and Brier score). The choice of confidence method rarely impacts accuracy significantly, but logit-based scoring methods lead to much better discrimination (AUROC 0.74-0.77) than black-box methods (AUROC 0.57-0.66). Replacing labels with single-token identifiers preserves discrimination but costs 3-6 accuracy points on average. We also introduce decision-only scoring, which only scores positions where labels diverge in the prefix tree (trie). It reduces decode steps by 88-96% on the three largest label sets and performs comparably to full-label scoring. The best open-weight model-method configurations (Gemma 4 31B and Qwen 3.5 9B) are competitive with the commercial Jev 1.13.0 classifier.
papers.title_ja: LLMはすでに信頼性認識型ゼロショット分類器である
papers.summary_ja: ゼロショットLLMのテキスト分類における信頼度評価手法を比較し、トークン確率やロジットに基づくホワイトボックス手法がブラックボックス手法より識別性能（AUROC）で優れることを示した。また、ラベルの分岐点のみをスコアリングする「決定のみスコアリング」により、デコードステップを最大96%削減しつつ同等の性能を維持できることを提案した。11種のオープンウェイトLLMを用いた評価では、Gemma 4 31BやQwen 3.5 9Bが商用分類器と競争力を持つことを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論効率化と評価手法に関わるが、軌道力学やサロゲートモデルとの直接の関連は薄い。

papers.title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
papers.summary: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%. Our further analysis shows that most failures come from misreading the screenshot, and that model reasoning rarely corrects a wrong belief but hallucinates evidence to defend it. To test whether such spatial abilities can be learned, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this gym. Its success rate rises from 1.6% to 33.1%, above Kimi K3, and it improves on all seven out-of-distribution benchmarks, including a 9.9-point gain on the real-world indoor videos of VSI-Bench. These results show that grounding spatial intelligence in screen actions exposes what MLLMs lack and offers a scalable way to teach it, with gains that transfer to real-world scenes. We will release TuringSpace to support further study.
papers.title_ja: TuringSpace: インタラクティブCAPTCHAによる空間知能の行動基盤構築
papers.summary_ja: マルチモーダル大規模言語モデル（MLLM）の空間理解と行動能力を評価・強化するための新しいベンチマーク「TuringSpace」を提案する。125種類のインタラクティブCAPTCHAを通じて、スクリーン操作による空間推論の能力を測定し、既存モデルが視覚情報の誤読やハルシネーションにより失敗しやすいことを示した。さらに、この環境でQwen3.5-9Bをファインチューニングすることで成功率を大幅に向上させ、実世界の室内動画ベンチマークでも性能が向上することを検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: MLLMのベンチマークとハルシネーション分析に関わるが、空間知能特化のため軌道力学との関連は薄い

papers.title: DL101 The Representation Capability of Neural Network Models
papers.summary: Universal approximation theorems (Cybenko, Funahashi, Hornik & Leshno) provide the mathematical justification for why neural networks are powerful enough to model complex, nonlinear phenomena. Shallow networks can approximate any continuous function on compact sets. Leshno's theorem clarified that non-polynomial activations are necessary for universality, which explains why ReLU, logistic, hyperbolic tangent, and other common activations work (but pure polynomials do not). However, approximation theorems provide no efficiency, training, nor generalization guarantees. They do not indicate how many neurons are needed for a given accuracy, whether gradient descent will find the right parameters, or whether networks trained on finite data will generalize well. Barron provided quantitative error bounds for particular function classes (approximation rates for functions with bounded Fourier norm), whereas Mont\'ufar was the first to show that expressivity grows exponentially with depth (in terms of the number of linear regions). Deep networks are strictly more expressive than shallow ones with the same number of parameters. Depth is fundamentally more powerful than width, providing a rigorous mathematical explanation for the use of deep learning models.
papers.title_ja: DL101 ニューラルネットワークモデルの表現能力
papers.summary_ja: ニューラルネットワークの普遍近似定理と、深層ネットワークが浅層ネットワークよりも表現力が高い理由を数学的に解説する。Barronの定量的誤差境界や、深さによる線形領域数の指数関数的増加を示すMontúfarの研究成果を概説する。近似定理が効率性や汎化性能を保証しない限界についても言及している。深層学習モデルの優位性を厳密な数学的根拠に基づいて説明する入門的なレビュー論文である。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の基礎理論であり、手法理解に有用だが応用特化ではないため

papers.title: Risk-optimal active learning with informative abstention
papers.summary: We study label acquisition when an oracle may abstain and its response probability shares parameters with the classifier. A query can then provide information through both a returned label and the response outcome. Under a correctly specified parametric model, we derive the classifier information after adjustment for response-model nuisance parameters. Combining this information with the local curvature of multiclass zero-one risk gives an acquisition criterion for minimizing the leading asymptotic excess risk. We characterize the optimal allocation under a fixed query budget and show how query allocation affects response identifiability. The oracle criterion reduces to response-discounted acquisition when response probability does not depend on the classifier parameters. Simulations examine the resulting query allocations and isolate the contribution of the response-outcome term through an ablation. A Consumer Complaints replay retains observed human abstentions and reveals benchmark labels upon response. Response-aware acquisition has lower mean test error than response-discounted acquisition at the two largest budgets, with paired differences significant after Holm correction. Entropy sampling performs better at the smallest budget. The gains depend on the response mechanism and query budget.
papers.title_ja: 情報的棄権を伴うリスク最適アクティブ学習
papers.summary_ja: オラクルが回答を棄権する可能性があり、その確率が分類器のパラメータと共有される場合のラベル取得問題を研究する。棄権という結果自体が情報源となることを考慮し、多クラスゼロワンリスクの局所曲率と組み合わせることで、漸近的過剰リスクを最小化する取得基準を導出する。固定予算下での最適割り当てを特徴付け、シミュレーションおよび実データ（消費者苦情）を用いた実験では、従来の手法より低いテスト誤差を示すことを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: ML手法全般に該当するが、軌道力学やLLM特化の関心とは直接結びつかないため中程度。

papers.title: Variance-Adaptive Upper Confidence Bounds for Multi-Armed Bandits with Kaplan--Meier Survival Estimation
papers.summary: We study the stochastic multi-armed bandit problem in which the reward associated with each arm is the survival probability at a pre-specified time horizon, and the observed outcome is a right-censored time-to-event variable. Standard bandit algorithms face delayed and partial observations in this setting. Prior adaptations for the Kaplan--Meier (KM) estimator rely on Hoeffding-type bounds that ignore the inherent heteroscedasticity of continuous survival processes. To bridge this gap, we propose KM-UCB, a variance-adaptive policy that unites continuous-time survival analysis with discrete sequential decision-making. By leveraging martingale theory and continuous influence functions, we derive a fixed-cohort empirical Bernstein bound parameterized by Greenwood's variance formula. For realtime allocation, we retain the Greenwood index and use a survival bound from completed records to review the recommended arm. Under catch-up reporting, the policy has logarithmic expected regret with an arm-specific variance term in the exploration bound. We evaluate the original policy in a dual-layer delayed simulation and a retrospective replay of breast cancer trial data, and evaluate the correction in a separate paired simulation.
papers.title_ja: Kaplan-Meier生存推定を用いた多腕バンディットにおける分散適応型上信頼境界
papers.summary_ja: 右検閲付き時間至イベントデータにおける多腕バンディット問題を対象に、Kaplan-Meier推定量の異分散性を考慮した新しいアルゴリズム「KM-UCB」を提案する。マルティンゲール理論と連続影響関数を用い、Greenwoodの分散公式に基づいた経験的Bernstein境界を導出することで、従来のHoeffding型境界の限界を克服した。この手法は、リアルタイム割り当ておよび追跡報告の両シナリオで対数的期待後悔を達成し、探索境界にアーム固有の分散項を含めることで効率化を実現する。乳がん臨床試験データの retrospection 解析およびシミュレーションにより、その有効性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の基礎手法だが、生存分析特化で軌道力学やLLMとは無関係

papers.title: Empirical Variational Bayes Factorization for Longitudinal Matrix Data
papers.summary: Collecting high-dimensional data over time for multiple individuals is increasingly common in biomedical research, particularly in studies of disease progression or molecular time-course experiments. Often data are missing or the timepoints are irregularly spaced across individuals. There is a lack of flexible methodology to explore latent patterns of change over time and account for missing data. We propose an empirical variational Bayes (EVB) approach to factorize high-dimensional longitudinal data, in which the underlying factors have temporal correlation over time. The EVB approach is computationally efficient and accommodates flexible covariance structures over time with automatic determination of all hyper-parameters (including the underlying rank, i.e., number of factors). Simulations demonstrate that the approach captures the underlying signal more precisely than other strategies, and performs well with respect to missing data imputation under different scenarios. An application to a gene time-course data for multiple sclerosis treatment provides a factorization with interpretable components over time and improved imputation accuracy for missing data.
papers.title_ja: 縦断行列データのための経験的変分ベイズ分解
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、時間的に相関を持つ潜在因子を持つ高次元縦断データに対する経験的変分ベイズ（EVB）手法を提案する。この手法は計算効率が高く、時間的な共分散構造を柔軟に扱えるだけでなく、潜在因子の数（ランク）を含むハイパーパラメータを自動決定できる。シミュレーションにより、他の戦略よりも正確にシグナルを捉え、欠損値補完においても優れた性能を示すことが確認された。多発性硬化症治療の遺伝子時間コースデータへの適用により、解釈可能な時間的コンポーネントの分解と、欠損値補完精度の向上が実証されている。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化やガウス過程に関連する統計手法だが、宇宙工学やLLM特化ではないため中程度。

papers.title: Auditing Learned Dynamics in Weather Models
papers.summary: Learned weather models are experimentally accessible computational systems whose internal representations can be inspected and manipulated. Using sparse autoencoder features from GraphCast, DeepMind's autoregressive weather forecasting model, we test whether causal relevance requires physical semantics, a question that matters for auditing whether AI forecasters used in high-assurance settings rely on reliable mechanisms. We also look at whether physically associated latent directions can be steered to improve extreme-event forecasts, where interventions are applied to the model's internal activations during the rollout. We find that ablating a feature locked to GraphCast's computational mesh increases global geopotential height error despite lacking conventional physical semantics. Second, suppressing convection- and low-level-vorticity-associated features weakens predicted tropical-cyclone deepening (the fall in central pressure during intensification), while amplifying them reduces intensity error, with amplification of convection features through feature scaling achieving a median of 51\% error reduction over seven storms. Together, these results separate interpretable, physical association from causal utility and establish sparse features as experimental coordinates for auditing and intervening on learned weather dynamics.
papers.title_ja: 気象モデルにおける学習されたダイナミクスの監査
papers.summary_ja: DeepMindの気象予測モデルGraphCastに対し、スパースオートエンコーダを用いた内部表現の解析と介入実験を行った。物理的意味を持たない特徴量であっても因果的に関連性を示すことを確認し、解釈可能性と因果的有用性の分離を明らかにした。また、対流や低層渦に関連する潜在方向を操作することで、熱帯低気圧の強度予測誤差を最大51%低減できることを実証した。本研究は、AI予測モデルの信頼性監査や極端現象予測の改善に向けた、内部活性化への介入手法を確立するものである。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理系モデルの解釈可能性と介入手法は、物理情報ニューラルネットやサロゲートモデルの信頼性評価に参考となるため。

papers.title: From Self-Play RL to Constrained Control: Distilling DiffMPC Students with DAgger
papers.summary: Self-play reinforcement learning (RL) produces strong driving policies, but these policies are hard to verify or interpret. Differentiable model predictive control (DiffMPC) can enforce explicit constraints, but it is usually trained by imitating logged data or with costly RL. To add constraints to an already trained policy, we keep a PPO teacher's backbone and replace its action head with a DiffMPC that enforces road boundary half-planes and agent ellipses. We then distill the student with DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator. Over 9 seeds, the constrained student of a smaller teacher matches its teacher on nuPlan and beats it on CARLA and on out-of-distribution Waymo scenes. For a stronger teacher, the student has fewer failures on nuPlan and Waymo, while staying level on CARLA. Its distillation takes no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.
papers.title_ja: 自己対戦強化学習から制約付き制御へ：DAggerを用いたDiffMPC生徒モデルの蒸留
papers.summary_ja: 自己対戦強化学習で訓練された運転ポリシーは検証が困難なため、明示的な制約を強制できる微分可能モデル予測制御（DiffMPC）を導入する。PPO教師モデルのバックボーンを維持しつつ、アクションヘッドを道路境界やエージェントの楕円制約を課すDiffMPCに置き換える。その後、教師の自己対戦シミュレータ内でDAggerを用いて生徒モデルを蒸留する。この手法により、より小さな教師モデルの制約付き生徒モデルはnuPlanで同等、CARLAおよび分布外Waymoシーンで教師を上回る性能を示し、蒸留時間は教師訓練の30%以下で済む。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と制御の融合だが、宇宙軌道やLLM効率化とは直接無関係

papers.title: Statistical, Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods for Missing Covariates: An Empirical Evaluation with Applications to Alzheimer's Disease Research
papers.summary: Missing data are common in biomedical research, particularly when biomarkers are costly or require invasive procedures to obtain, such as cerebrospinal fluid measures in Alzheimer's disease. Although a wide range of missing data methods exists, from traditional statistical approaches to modern machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms, their comparative performance under different missingness mechanisms remains insufficiently understood. In this study, we provide an empirical evaluation of eight methods for handling missing covariates, including complete-case analysis, multiple imputation, ML-based techniques, and DL frameworks such as multilayer perceptrons, variational autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks. We summarize their conceptual foundations, practical implementation considerations, strengths, and limitations. Through extensive simulations, we assess estimation bias, efficiency, standard error accuracy, confidence interval coverage, and computational burden across different missingness mechanisms and proportions. An application to the Vanderbilt Memory and Aging Project further illustrates the implications of different methods for regression analysis in a real-world biomedical setting. Finally, we provide practical recommendations for method selection and highlight remaining challenges that warrant future investigation.
papers.title_ja: 欠損共変量への統計的・機械学習・深層学習手法：アルツハイマー病研究を応用した実証的評価
papers.summary_ja: 生体医学研究における欠損データ処理手法として、従来の統計手法からVAEやGANなどの深層学習フレームワークまで8つの手法を比較評価した。異なる欠損メカニズム下での推定バイアス、効率性、標準誤差の精度、信頼区間のカバー率、計算負荷をシミュレーションで検証した。バンダービルト記憶と老化プロジェクトのデータを用いた実証分析を通じて、実務的な手法選択の指針を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ML/DL手法の比較評価だが、対象が医療データであり軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係

papers.title: Ferrofluid Shape Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Ferrofluids are liquids containing magnetic nanoparticles, enabling shape control through external magnetic fields. This deformability supports their use as soft robotic bodies that can navigate confined spaces and manipulate objects. Their nonlinear continuum dynamics, however, make reliable control challenging. Existing work shows how spatial magnetic fields from electromagnet arrays can establish and maintain desired ferrofluid configurations. A complementary objective is to exploit the fluid's dynamics under limited actuation to reach prescribed shapes that may not be sustainable at equilibrium. Here, we use deep model-based reinforcement learning to control these transient shapes. Learning directly through physical interaction, our policies select current commands for a single fixed electromagnet based on visual observations, guiding the moving ferrofluid toward prescribed geometries. The learned policies repeatedly attain a variety of shapes spanning polygons, asterisks and pentominoes. These results demonstrate that learning directly from physical interaction enables reliable fluid shaping, opening new possibilities for controlling ferrofluid-based soft robots.
papers.title_ja: 深層強化学習によるフェロ流体の形状制御
papers.summary_ja: 磁気ナノ粒子を含むフェロ流体の非線形連続体力学に対し、深層モデルベース強化学習を適用した。単一の固定電磁石への電流指令を視覚情報に基づいて決定し、平衡状態では維持できない一時的な形状への遷移を制御する。学習されたポリシーは多角形や星形など多様な幾何学形状を繰り返し達成した。物理的相互作用からの直接学習により、フェロ流体ベースのソフトロボットの信頼性のある形状制御が可能になったことを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の応用だが、対象が流体制御であり軌道力学やLLMとは無関係

papers.title: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/.
papers.title_ja: WEVO: 全身型ロコモニピュレーションのためのワールドモデル活用VLA最適化
papers.summary_ja: ヒューマノイドロボットの全身制御において、強化学習（RL）による視覚言語行動（VLA）ポリシーの改善手法を提案する。シミュレータのギャップを補うため、行動条件付きビデオワールドモデル（WM）を構築し、テレオペレーションなしで後学習を行う。WMとVLA、全身コントローラを閉ループRL環境として統合し、実機での成功률을23.3%から75.0%へ向上させた。シミュレーションによる初期化と、実機観測に整列したWMによる改善の両利点を活用する枠組みである。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とワールドモデルの活用は関心領域だが、対象がロボット制御であり軌道力学やLLM効率化とは異なるため中程度。

papers.title: Process-Knowledge-Guided Latent Diffusion for Generative Design of Porous Architectures: A Case Study in Aerosol Jet Printing
papers.summary: Printed porous layouts interleave functional material with open channels, and the layout that uses the material best depends on how the process settings shape the deposit. Generative models propose layouts quickly, but a generator that does not receive the process setting samples from the same distribution at every setting, even when the process-dependent score ranks candidate layouts differently. This paper examines whether process knowledge can steer a latent diffusion generator toward layouts suited to a given process setting in a prescribed design domain. We formulate a process-dependent utilization score in which a process model sets the length over which the utility of printed material decays with distance from a channel. The generator combines a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) latent representation, a topology U-Net, a ControlNet domain branch, and a separately trained regressor that predicts the score from noised latents; the domain branch conditions each denoising step and the regressor gradient steers it. The method is applied to aerosol jet printing, where the atomizer and sheath gas flows enter the score through the flow-focusing relation. Across seven modeled flow settings, the lowest-scoring candidate layout of a domain differed between settings in 191 of 500 domains. In a sampling study, the mean directly computed score on three validation domains and one test domain was 0.642 with domain conditioning alone, 0.636 at a weight of 300, and 0.450 at 12,000 (112 scores per weight; lower is better). The results support process-knowledge-guided generation as an approach to process-specific porous design under the stated assumptions.
papers.title_ja: 多孔質構造の創発的デザインにおけるプロセス知識誘導型潜在拡散モデル：エアロゾルジェットプリンティングのケーススタディ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、製造プロセス設定に応じた多孔質構造の生成を目的に、潜在拡散モデル（Latent Diffusion）にプロセス知識を統合する手法を提案する。VQ-VAEとトポロジーU-Net、ControlNetを用いた生成器に加え、ノイズ付き潜在変数からスコアを予測する回帰器を訓練し、その勾配でデノイジングステップを誘導する。エアロゾルジェットプリンティングを例に、原子化器やシースガスフローによる影響をスコア関数に組み込み、プロセス依存性の高い設計領域での性能を検証した。結果、プロセス条件のみでは得られなかった最適解を、適切な重み付けによりより高精度に生成できることを示し、プロセス知識誘導型生成の有効性を確認した。

papers.title: PsyWorld: Profile-Conditioned World Modeling for Human Behavior Prediction
papers.summary: Understanding how stable psychometric traits and time-varying states jointly inform behavior is an important problem in computational behavioral science. Existing personalized agents commonly condition actions directly on a static profile, leaving realized state transitions unused as an explicit source of supervision. We introduce a profile-conditioned state world model that uses observed environment--behavior state transitions to learn transition-informed representations for behavioral prediction. During training, a posterior encoder quantizes realized transitions, while a prior predicts the resulting codes from the psychometric profile and pre-transition context. The prior code and predicted next state then condition macro-level behavior and simulator-grounded execution. Thus, the world model provides structured transition supervision instead of treating personality as a direct action descriptor. We evaluate the framework in VEET, a controlled behavioral simulator with human trajectories, and in AgentSociety as a structurally different synthetic environment. A participant-disjoint split of 240 training, 25 validation, and 48 test participants evaluates generalization to unseen people. On VEET, the model reaches 0.904 Top-1 accuracy (95\% CI: [0.895, 0.913]) and 0.0033 Macro KL. Ablations associate continuous next-state modeling with most of the Top-1 gain, while discrete codes and prior alignment mainly improve Top-3 and distributional alignment. These results establish transition-informed world-model supervision as useful for subject-generalized behavior prediction, without implying causal psychological mechanisms or calibrated long-horizon state dynamics.
papers.title_ja: PsyWorld: 人間行動予測のためのプロファイル条件付きワールドモデリング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、心理学的特性（プロファイル）と時間変化する状態遷移を統合し、人間行動を予測するワールドモデルを提案する。既存の手法が静的なプロファイルのみを行動の条件として用いるのに対し、本研究では環境と行動の状態遷移を観察し、後方エンコーダと前方予測器を用いて遷移情報を表現学習に組み込む。VEETシミュレータおよびAgentSocietyでの評価により、未知の被験者に対する汎化性能を示し、Top-1精度0.904を達成した。アブレーションスタディにより、連続的な次状態モデリングが予測精度向上に最も寄与することが明らかになった。
papers.relevance_reason: エージェント設計と状態遷移モデリングの手法は関連するが、対象が行動科学であり軌道力学やLLM効率化とは遠い

papers.title: On the Impact of Feature Reduction Techniques on Adversarial Attacks
papers.summary: Adversarial attacks have posed significant threats to machine learning models by exploiting their inherent vulnerabilities. Researchers have established an interdisciplinary field called adversarial machine learning to explore these vulnerabilities and develop corresponding defense strategies. Feature reduction strategies are used to decrease the dimensionality of the data in order to reduce training time, avoid the curse of dimensionality, prevent overfitting, and mitigate redundant features. However, their effect on adversarial robustness across different classifiers and attack scenarios remains insufficiently explored. This study aims to analyze the effect of feature reduction techniques on the adversarial robustness of a diverse set of machine learning models under poisoning, backdoor, and universal adversarial perturbation attacks on the APT dataset. These models include support vector machine, decision tree, random forest, multi-layer perceptron, and k-nearest neighbors. The attained results are compared with scenarios where different feature reduction techniques are applied, including principal component analysis, permutation importance ranking, recursive feature elimination, and univariate mutual information. Metrics such as accuracy, F1-score, and mitigation score are employed to evaluate the effect of these techniques on adversarial robustness. The results demonstrate that permutation importance ranking and univariate mutual information generally provide the most consistent robustness improvements, while other methods exhibit more variable effects depending on the classifier and attack scenario.
papers.title_ja: 敵対的攻撃における特徴量削減手法の影響について
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、機械学習モデルに対する敵対的攻撃（ポイズニング、バックドア、ユニバーサル敵対的摂動）において、特徴量削減手法が頑健性に与える影響を分析する。SVMやランダムフォレストなどの多様な分類器を用い、PCAやパーミュテーション重要度ランキングなどの4つの次元削減手法を比較評価した。結果として、パーミュテーション重要度ランキングと単変量相互情報量が、他の手法よりも一貫して頑健性の向上をもたらすことが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: ML手法全般に関わるが、LLMや軌道力学といった主要関心領域とは直接関連が薄い。

papers.title: EuclidFM: Foundation Model for Compact Photometric Survey Representation
papers.summary: We present EuclidFM, a compact self-supervised model that learns object-level representations from heterogeneous catalogue photometry in Euclid Quick Data Release 1. Using 90,258 sources across three Euclid Deep Fields, a masked-autoencoder Transformer reconstructs withheld fluxes and uncertainties from available measurements, producing a 128-dimensional embedding per source. The embeddings encode morphological and photometric information: sources with high point-like probability have, on average, 12.4 similarly classified neighbours among their 15 nearest neighbours, compared with 4.3 under field- and magnitude-stratified randomization. Linear models trained on frozen embeddings predict VIS magnitudes with correlations of 0.954-0.980 across three held-out fields. For sources with VIS aperture-flux uncertainties up to 1 microJy, incorporating embeddings reduces the root-mean-square error in predicted log uncertainty by at least 24% relative to a magnitude-only model. A classifier trained on spectroscopically confirmed sources identifies 1,150 quasar candidates, but only 21 of the 156 candidates with accepted external counterparts show AGN evidence, including 12 spectroscopic quasars. The classifier's transferability to the wider photometric catalogue therefore remains uncertain, and its purity and completeness require further evaluation. Independently of classification, EuclidFM provides a common representation for downstream survey analyses when photometric coverage differs between sources. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AI-Driven-HEP/EuclidFM.
papers.title_ja: EuclidFM: コンパクトな光度サーベイ表現のための基盤モデル
papers.summary_ja: EuclidFMは、Euclid観測データから自己教師あり学習により天体の埋め込み表現を生成するコンパクトな基盤モデルである。マスクト・オートエンコーダ型Transformerを用い、欠損した光度や不確実性を再構成することで、128次元のベクトルとして天体の形態・光度情報を圧縮する。凍結させた埋め込み表現を用いた線形モデルは、VISバンドの等級予測で高い相関を示し、不確実性の予測精度も向上させる。また、クエーサー候補の分類にも適用したが、転移学習の汎化性能についてはさらなる評価が必要とされている。

papers.title: Fast and Memory-Light Evaluation of Density-Based Clusterings with the DISCO Index in R
papers.summary: DISCO is a recent internal cluster validity index for density-based clustering that, unlike earlier indices, also evaluates the quality of noise labels. The discoCVI package makes DISCO available in R. This article describes the design of the package and a typical workflow, in which DISCO is used to compare clusterings and to choose the parameters of HDBSCAN without ground truth, followed by the implementation introduced in version 0.2.0. DISCO is defined through density-connectivity distances between all pairs of points, so direct implementations store several n-by-n matrices. We show that every quantity DISCO needs can be read off the single-linkage merge tree of the mutual-reachability minimum spanning tree, so that the index can be computed exactly with memory that grows linearly with the number of points, while the running time remains quadratic as in the original definition. The implementation is tested against the previous version, agrees with the original Python implementation to within $3 \times 10^{-13}$, and corrects the score of singleton clusters to match the published definition. In benchmarks, discoCVI is 23 to 138 times faster than its previous version for 500 to 4,000 points and 3 to 9 times faster than the Python reference for 500 to 8,000 points, using a fraction of the memory of both, and it scores 100,000 points in about 50 seconds with less than 200 MB of memory.
papers.title_ja: RにおけるDISCO指数を用いた密度ベースクラスタリングの高速かつメモリ効率の良い評価
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、密度ベースクラスタリングの内部妥当性指標であるDISCOをRパッケージ「discoCVI」で実装し、その設計とワークフローを解説する。従来の実装ではn×n行列の保存が必要であったが、相互到達性最小全域木（MST）の単一連結マージツリーから必要な量を抽出することで、メモリ使用量を線形に削減しつつ計算精度を維持する手法を提案する。ベンチマークでは、既存のR実装比で最大138倍、Python参照実装比で最大9倍の高速化と大幅なメモリ削減を実証した。

papers.title: Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes
papers.summary: The sample compression conjecture is a longstanding open problem in learning theory, originating in the work of Littlestone and Warmuth in the 1980s. At its heart is a connection between simplification and generalization: if a predictor consistent with a training sample is defined using only a small part of that sample, then it is likely to generalize. Sample compression schemes formalize this idea, and many natural learning algorithms can be analyzed this way. The sample compression conjecture of Floyd and Warmuth (1995) asserts that every binary concept class of VC dimension $d$ admits a sample compression scheme of size $O(d)$; a weaker conjecture asks only for size polynomial in $d$. Both have remained open: the first bound depending only on $d$, due to Moran and Yehudayoff (2016), is exponential in $d$. We prove the weaker conjecture by constructing a sample compression scheme of size $O(d^2 \log^2 d)$.
papers.title_ja: 全VCクラスにおけるほぼ二次のサンプル圧縮
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、学習理論における長年の未解決問題であるサンプル圧縮予想の弱い版を証明するものである。VC次元dを持つバイナリ概念クラスに対し、サイズO(d^2 log^2 d)のサンプル圧縮スキームを構築した。これにより、訓練サンプルの一部のみで予測器を定義することで汎化性能が保証されるという理論的基盤が強化された。既存の指数関数的な境界を大幅に改善し、多項式サイズの圧縮可能性を実証した。

papers.title: Density Feedback Control for Transferability of Generative Sparse Adversarial Attacks
papers.summary: Generator-based sparse adversarial attacks train encoder--decoder networks to produce transferable sparse perturbations for black-box robustness evaluation. Their perturbation density, however, is set only indirectly by a fixed sparsity coefficient whose mapping to density is unknown and shifts during training, so reaching a target density requires re-tuning; this fixed pressure also yields little transferability gain once density reduction begins. We propose Density Feedback Control (DFC), which tightens or relaxes this coefficient at the end of each epoch according to the gap between the observed hard-mask density and the target, without changing the generator architecture or loss. At a 10\% target density, DFC brings the mean density of three base attacks within one percentage point of the target in a single run and improves the transfer attack success rate (ASR) of two of them on CNN and Transformer targets, including under per-image $\ell_0$ budgets, while perturbing fewer pixels. Tracing GPG's training, we observe that as DFC relaxes the coefficient, the transfer ASR recovers with the density and overtakes the fixed-coefficient baseline with fewer pixels. For EGS-TSSA, which restricts perturbations to source-model feature-importance regions, DFC yields no consistent gain; we analyze how this restriction interacts with density feedback.
papers.title_ja: 生成型スパース敵対的攻撃の転移可能性のための密度フィードバック制御
papers.summary_ja: 生成型スパース敵対的攻撃において、固定スパース係数による密度制御の非線形性と転移性能の低下問題を解決するため、密度フィードバック制御（DFC）を提案する。各エポック終了時に観測密度と目標密度の乖離に基づき係数を動的に調整することで、アーキテクチャや損失関数を変更せずに目標密度を高精度に達成する。実験により、CNNおよびTransformerターゲットに対して、より少ないピクセル数で転移攻撃成功率（ASR）を向上させることを示した。ただし、ソースモデルの特徴重要度領域に制限をかける手法では一貫した改善が見られず、その相互作用も分析している。

papers.title: Learning to Verify: Signature-Guided Training for Adaptive Adversarial Detection
papers.summary: Adversarial example detectors often fail when attackers explicitly attempt to bypass them. We propose a dual-model approach that keeps the original classifier fixed and trains a separate verifier to assess its predictions. During training, we identify patterns of internal neural network activations that distinguish genuine examples of each class from adversarial examples targeting that class. These patterns, called activation signatures, guide the generation of challenging adversarial examples that mislead the classifier, challenge the verifier, and internally resemble the target class. The verifier learns to recognize these examples while preserving its performance on clean inputs through knowledge distillation. At inference, the verifier evaluates the classifier's prediction without requiring activation signatures. We evaluate the approach on publicly available datasets against several adaptive attacks, including attacks unseen during training. The proposed verifier substantially outperforms directly attacked confidence-based and feature-based detectors under the evaluated L-infinity attacks. Ablation studies show that adaptive verifier training is the main source of this improvement, while signature guidance primarily benefits clean accuracy. Additional L2 evaluations reveal limitations in robustness across perturbation types.
papers.title_ja: 検証を学ぶ：シグネチャ誘導型トレーニングによる適応型敵対的検出

papers.title: Reject and Report: Forgery-Evident Undetectable Watermarks for Generative Image Models
papers.summary: Provenance schemes such as those based on content watermarks let images from a generative model be traced back to it. A practical watermarking scheme must be accurate at a low false-positive rate (FPR), robust under content-preserving processing, and undetectable. In addition, it must resist forgery; otherwise, even from a single watermarked image and a surrogate model, an adversary can imprint the watermark onto an arbitrary image or regenerate new content that carries it, falsely attributing harmful content to a model or making authentic photographs appear AI-generated. We argue that a watermarking scheme should not only reject forgeries but also report them: a forgery rejected as unwatermarked leaves no trace of the attempt. State-of-the-art forgery-resilient undetectable watermarking schemes, such as SemBind, fall short on both counts. External anomaly detectors that do report forgeries either miss most of them or falsely flag genuine images after common processing. We propose Tripwire-WM, the first forgery-evident framework for undetectable watermarks. It commits the semantics of the generated image to the magnitudes of the initial latent noise, which the sign-based watermarks leave unused, through a distribution-preserving embedding; a forged image carries a valid watermark but with a commitment that does not match its content, so the detector both rejects it and reports it as forged. Built on the pseudorandom code (PRC) watermark and Gaussian Shading++, Tripwire-WM provably preserves their undetectability. On MS-COCO, with the owner's own model as the surrogate, it accepts no imprinting forgery, compared with up to 55.0% for SemBind, and reports all of them as forged; it also accepts at most 1.8% of reprompting forgeries, against up to 46.2% for SemBind. Meanwhile, it accepts at least 99% of genuine watermarked images at 10^{-6} FPR and matches the robustness of the base schemes.
papers.title_ja: 拒否と報告：生成画像モデル向けの偽造が明白な検出不能ウォーターマーク

papers.title: Long-Range Video Presentation Attack Detection: A Three-Class Benchmark Across 1-100 m and Two Sensor Types
papers.summary: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) systems deployed in border control and airport surveillance are constrained by a critical assumption: subjects are captured at close range, typically under one meter. No existing benchmark systematically addresses multi-distance capture, diverse environmental conditions, and concurrent spoofing and occlusion-based attacks, leaving deployed models underprepared for real-world scenarios. We introduce a video-based PAD dataset of 374,000+ frames from 261 unique identities collected across five standoff distances (1 m-100 m) under indoor and outdoor conditions using a DSLR camera (C) and a mobile sensor (M), with three-class labels: live, spoof, and props (occlusions); models are trained and evaluated on video clips rather than single frames. We fine-tune and benchmark four CNN architectures: MobileNetV3, MobileNet, EfficientNet, and ResNet-50. The higher-resolution DSLR maintains near-perfect spoof classification rate across all distances, while the lower-resolution mobile sensor degrades sharply beyond 50 m, with props classification rate dropping to 55% at 75 m for MobileNetV3. EfficientNet achieves the best overall performance (98.48% accuracy, ACER 2.01%). Generalization tests on unseen attack datasets yield 89-94% accuracy, validating cross-domain robustness. These results establish capture distance and sensor resolution as critical but underexplored axes of PAD difficulty. The dataset will be publicly released under an End-User License Agreement to support reproducible long-range PAD research.
